# The nine sources of an implementation link

This is the product's own list of the sources an implementation link may come from. A link between
a piece of work and the code that does it may come from any of these:

- explicit human/Agent declaration;
- repository/directory structure;
- package manifests;
- import/include graphs;
- build graph;
- launch/config relationships;
- observed historical modifications;
- deterministic dependency analysis;
- LLM inference.

They are not equally true, and a reader is told which one a link came from.
